text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From today, I'll be training Mejiro Bright, an easygoing, free-spirited member of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may be slow to start and accelerate, but something about her shines through in the final stretch.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her leisurely manner, she's determined to one day become the new light of the Mejiros—and I'm itching to see where that goal will take her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I decide to watch over her through her participation in the Twinkle Series.
